notes.title: Alpha Patch #3 + GIFT
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers,

Gatewalkers alpha tests have been going on for some time now and we will be slowly finishing them (we'll give you the exact date later). To appreciate the fact that you are with us, we have prepared a small gift for you! It is an exclusive item, only for alpha players, A GUILD MEMBER CAPE. Take a look!

Everyone who logs in to the game should find a guild cape in their inventory and receive a recipe for its creation.

With this update, we have also make some minor changes and fixes:
- minor FX glitches
- minor graphic problems
- navigation issues in few places
- small technical issues

Best of luck Gatewalkers!
Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Alpha Patch #2
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers,

We have uploaded a second patch for the alpha version of the game. Most important fixes are pointed below:

[list]
[*] fix of an issue that allows you to duplicate items in your inventory
[*] fix of the problem where some of the players can not load expedition (endless loading)
[*] fix the problem where some of the players encountered DC after clicking the "PLAY" button
[*] fix of minor fixes of graphical glitches and minor stability issues
[/list]

We hope you are still enjoying playing Gatewalkers! 
The alpha is slowly coming to an end. The exact alpha end date will be announced soon.

Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Alpha Patch #1
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers,

We have uploaded a first big fix for the current alpha version of the game. Below you have more detail about them:

[list]
[*] fix of nickname issue, where players could not play because of their player's name on steam had illegal characters or is too short / too long. Now players can change the character name at the login screen.
[*] fix of problem where players had no starting equipment and empty storage chest
[*] fix of some login server issues
[*] fix of Surian Guardian Secret Chest. Now Surian forest secret box guardians are spawning correctly and this box drops appropriate reward
[*] fix of lack of gem to craft Stamina Ring. Now players can find Peridot gem in challenge boxes and secret boxes.
[*] fix of minor fixes of graphical glitches and minor stability issues
[/list]

We hope you are still enjoying playing Gatewalkers, and all players that were unable to play now will try the game!

Gatewalkers Dev Team
